_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for viewport-test exemptions. Components listed here are internal/utility and never rendered standalone on an operator page -- overflow is handled by the parent that composes them. Edit this file ONCE: both the CI gate (admin-ui/src/test/viewport-checks.js -> EXEMPT_FROM_VIEWPORT_TEST) and the operator Viewport Debt panel (backend/app/viewport_debt.py -> _load_exempt_components) read this file directly, so there is no parallel hand-edited copy to keep in sync. `exempt` is an object mapping component name -> one-line justification (the justification is documentation only; CI uses the keys).

exempt.ErrorBoundary: Internal decorator component for error isolation; not operator-facing.
exempt.MarkdownContent: Pure presentation: renders markdown blocks, used in help/documentation panels where overflow is already handled by parent scroll container.
exempt.ColumnsPicker: Utility component: renders chip columns in KanbanBoard's table; layout controlled entirely by parent, not rendering standalone in operator pages.
exempt.Toasts: Toast notifications: positioned fixed/absolutely, exempt from viewport flow overflow checks; positioned via Tailwind fixed positioning.
exempt.MessageBubble: Message-row sub-component rendered exclusively inside MessagesPanel; viewport coverage is provided by MessagesPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises the bubble inline (overflow, text-truncation, touch-target).
exempt.MessageAttachments: Attachment-chip row rendered exclusively inside MessageBubble; viewport coverage is provided by MessagesPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises the bubble (and its attachments) inline.
exempt.MessagesPanelHeader: Header (title badges, webhook popover, toolbar, search, saved-views strip) rendered exclusively inside MessagesPanel; viewport coverage is provided by MessagesPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.MessagesComposer: Bottom compose area (reply bar, type dropdown, textarea, send) rendered exclusively inside MessagesPanel; viewport coverage is provided by MessagesPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.MessagesBatchActionBar: Batch-action bar rendered exclusively inside MessagesPanel when select-mode is active; viewport coverage is provided by MessagesPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.CatchUpNeedsAttentionSection: Needs-attention worklist sub-component rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.CatchUpRemediationPipelineSection: Remediation-pipeline funnel sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.CatchUpStatsRow: Headline stats-row sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.CatchUpNarrativeSummary: Narrative-summary + trend-pill sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.CatchUpLatestCycleSection: Latest-strategic-cycle card sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.CatchUpMemoPathwaySection: Memo-pathway metrics sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.CatchUpResearchYieldSection: Research-yield funnel sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.CatchUpRecentCompletionsSection: Recent-completions list sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.CategoryRow: Per-category trend row rendered exclusively inside SrTrendBreakdown (card and inline variants); viewport coverage is provided by SrTrendBreakdown.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.SrDiagnosticsStack: SR diagnostics stack rendered exclusively inside DashboardHome; viewport coverage is provided by DashboardHome.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.PipelineEfficiencyPanel: Pipeline-efficiency stat strip rendered exclusively inside DashboardHome; viewport coverage is provided by DashboardHome.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.FailureClassPill: Failure-class pill rendered exclusively inside DashboardHome's failure-breakdown row; viewport coverage is provided by DashboardHome.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.SystemHealthCard: System-health actionable-issues card rendered exclusively inside DashboardHome; viewport coverage is provided by DashboardHome.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.

exempt.DirectionsPanelHeader: Tab/title header sub-component rendered exclusively inside DirectionsPanel; viewport coverage is provided by DirectionsPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline (overflow, text-truncation, touch-target at 375px).
exempt.DirectionsAddForm: Add-direction form sub-component rendered exclusively inside DirectionsPanel; viewport coverage is provided by DirectionsPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.DirectionsQuickLinks: Quick-links nav sub-component rendered exclusively inside DirectionsPanel; viewport coverage is provided by DirectionsPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.DirectionsList: Directions list sub-component rendered exclusively inside DirectionsPanel; viewport coverage is provided by DirectionsPanel.viewport.test.tsx (including the dense stress fixture) which exercises it inline.
exempt.FleetCapacityCard: Fleet capacity stat card rendered exclusively inside DashboardHome; viewport coverage is provided by DashboardHome.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.StrategicChallengeChip: Compact verdict chip rendered exclusively inside SystemStatusCard and MessagesPanel; viewport coverage is provided by SystemStatusCard.viewport.test.tsx and MessagesPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercise it inline.
exempt.TaskDetailDrawerPrimitives: Dependency-free presentational primitives (CopyableId, SectionHeader, DetailRow, Sparkline, DependencyItem, DirectionsSection) rendered exclusively inside DetailsTab in TaskDetailDrawerMeta; never standalone, overflow handled by the composing parent; viewport coverage is provided by TaskDetailDrawerMeta.viewport.test.tsx which exercises them inline.
exempt.TaskDetailDrawerSections: Domain section sub-components (compute jobs, research origin, adversarial gate, blocked need, knowledge document, evaluation summary, panel review verdict, acceptance evidence) rendered exclusively inside DetailsTab in TaskDetailDrawerMeta; viewport coverage is provided by TaskDetailDrawerMeta.viewport.test.tsx which exercises them inline.

exempt.WarmVmRows: Row-level sub-components (PoolCostGuardBanner, funnel snapshots, pool rows) extracted from WarmVmPanel during size refactor; rendered exclusively inside WarmVmPanel; viewport coverage is provided by WarmVmPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises them inline.
exempt.ProblemModelAttention: Exports PendingConfirmationList (the 'Needs your attention' worklist of pending operator confirmations); rendered exclusively inside ProblemModelViewer's overflow-y-auto scroll container (which absorbs the dense interactive rows' horizontal extent into an inner scroll region rather than overflowing the page); viewport coverage is provided by ProblemModelViewer.viewport.test.tsx which exercises the pending list inline at 375px.
exempt.StrategicContextArtifactSlot: Descriptor-renderer sub-component rendered exclusively inside StrategicContextRail; viewport coverage is provided by StrategicContextRail.viewport.test.tsx, including the composed Chat sideboard artifact-slot assertion.
exempt.TaskDetailDrawerSideboardContext: Task context sub-section rendered exclusively inside TaskDetailDrawerMeta/TaskDetailDrawer; viewport coverage is provided by TaskDetailDrawerMeta.viewport.test.tsx and TaskDetailDrawer.viewport.test.tsx, which exercise the drawer composition inline.
exempt.CommandPaletteHost: Thin App-level wrapper around CommandPalette; viewport coverage is provided by CommandPalette.viewport.test.tsx, which exercises the rendered palette directly.
exempt.CriterionVerdictBadge: Compact knowledge-document badge rendered exclusively inside KnowledgeBrowser rows/details; viewport coverage is provided by KnowledgeBrowser.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.StrategicContextDescriptor: Composer/receipt context chip rendered exclusively inside MessagesComposer and MessageBubble; viewport coverage is provided by MessagesComposer.viewport.test.tsx and MessagesPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.StrategicContextMap: Context-map visualization rendered inside StrategicContextWorkspace and StrategicContextArtifactSlot; viewport coverage is provided by StrategicContextWorkspace.viewport.test.tsx and StrategicContextRail.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.StrategicSessionEvents: Session-event list rendered inside StrategicContextWorkspace and StrategicContextRail; viewport coverage is provided by StrategicContextWorkspace.viewport.test.tsx and StrategicContextRail.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.MarkdownContentInner: Lazy-loaded inner implementation of MarkdownContent; never rendered standalone — always composed via MarkdownContent which wraps it in a Suspense boundary. Viewport coverage is provided by MarkdownContent.viewport.test.tsx which exercises the rendered output at 375px.
exempt.RailMiniCanvas: Compact SVG canvas visualization rendered exclusively inside StrategicContextRail's context section; never rendered standalone — viewport coverage is provided by StrategicContextRail.viewport.test.tsx which exercises the rail composition inline.
exempt.DashboardMetricCardsPrimitives: Dependency-free presentational primitives (Skeleton, FAILURE_CLASS_COLORS) extracted from DashboardMetricCards to break the recharts dependency in the main bundle; never rendered standalone — all consumers are sub-components covered by their own viewport tests.
exempt.AttachmentPreviewModal: Fixed-position dialog overlay for attachment preview (image/PDF/download); rendered conditionally only when a user clicks an attachment — overflow is handled by the modal's internal overflow-auto scroll container and max-h/max-w viewport constraints.
exempt.FleetRunnerConfigPanel: Runner config editor (max-concurrent, GPU allowlist, per-job GPU count, task-type allowlist) rendered exclusively inside FleetRunnersPanel's expanded runner row; never rendered standalone — viewport coverage is provided by FleetRunnersPanel.viewport.test.tsx which composes it inline via the runner config block.
exempt.MessageAttachments: Attachment chip list rendered exclusively inside MessageBubble; viewport coverage is provided by MessagesPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises message bubbles with attachments inline.
